# CWE-798: Stripe API key — sk_live_... live secret key.
# sk_live_... is a live Stripe key that can move money. The rule flags
# that prefix; ok is sk_test or bare prefix without entropy.
# ruleid: detected-stripe-api-key
sk_live_xf2fh0Hu3LqXlqqUg2DEWhEz
# ruleid: detected-stripe-api-key
stripe_key=sk_live_1234567890abcdef12345678
# ok: detected-stripe-api-key
sk_live_
# ok: detected-stripe-api-key
sk_test_123
# ruleid: detected-stripe-api-key
sk_live_CCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCCC
# ruleid: detected-stripe-api-key
sk_live_DDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDDD
# ok: detected-stripe-api-key
sk_test_examplePlaceholderNotLiveKey1234567890
